title: Q15
description:
“Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt.”
Read: Exo 2:11–15, Psa 89:50–51, Exo 3:7–10
a) Psa 89:50–51 speaks of “the reproach of Your servants” and of enemies who “have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.” What does that bring forward into “the reproach of Christ” that Moses chose with the people of God?
b) Exo 2:14–15 says Moses feared and fled. Hebrews 11:27 says he did not fear the king's wrath. Which event in Moses' life does each fit (compare Exo 10:28–29)?
